subject: realized tip states in stochastic maps

messages.author: d3c9ac62d374695a
messages.subject: realized tip states in stochastic maps
parts:
Dear Nick,

In your 09/23 post, you mentioned a trick to coerce complicated changes occur on a branch. I am working with a stochastic map where there is a late branching event that leads to a lineage that occurs a lot of areas. More specifically, at the node leading to this tip, the cladogenetic event is EAIFDC->E,EAIFDC, and then the tip in question must get from E to EFGHC in a short amount of time. In all of the stochastic maps that I've produced, this doesn't happen (i.e., usually only two of the correct areas occur at the end). Is there an option that I can fiddle with here, or something I should be looking out for?

Thanks in advance!

Jonathan
